name: Repository Inspector
description: Inspect an existing codebase with Codex or Cursor CLI in read-only mode and return structured implementation context.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.placeholder: Describe what to inspect or investigate, e.g. Analyze auth workflow for {{test}}
inputs.helpText: Prompt sent to the CLI. Supports variables like {{test}}.

inputs.name: repositoryPath
inputs.label: Repository Path Override
inputs.helpText: Optional override; it must remain inside the project's allowed repository roots.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model Override
inputs.helpText: Model to use for Codex CLI inspection (e.g. gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol). Defaults to gpt-5.6-terra or CODEX_MODEL.

inputs.name: cacheResult
inputs.label: Cache Last Result
inputs.helpText: Store the latest execution result in the database cache. When running in Debug mode with 'Use Cache' enabled, this cached result will be reused instead of calling the CLI.
